description: This file contains the PHP class `Location` in the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Localisation`. The class extends the base Controller and provides methods for listing, editing, and creating localisation location entries in an OpenCart admin interface. It manages data fetching, view rendering, URL construction, and CRUD operations related to localisation locations.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Controller class for managing localisation location data within the OpenCart admin panel, providing listing, form, and save functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method to load the location list page with filtering, sorting, pagination, and location data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of locations, typically called via AJAX, with filtered and sorted data.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the view for displaying a paginated, sorted list of locations with additional UI elements.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a location, pre-filling data if editing an existing record.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission to save or update location data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected location entries, performing permission checks and batch delete operations.
